relations.subject: PublicationBundle
relations.invariant: Require separate native permission and canonical authorization for the closed bundle. Historic receipt recovery checks the original operation, expected selector and observed postimage.

relations.subject: CompatibilityAssessment
relations.invariant: Retained reads preserve exact bytes. Upgrades require reviewed bijective edge mapping or a separately reviewed meaning change. Digest the selected formal voice, boundaries and scope with a versioned canonical serializer.

relations.subject: LifecycleTransition
relations.invariant: Closure declares the consumer universe, cut and traversal evidence. Unknown consumers, missing cursors or truncation block effects. Permission and owner review refer to the same proposal.

relations.subject: JoinTransition
relations.invariant: Terminal phases preserve history. Unknown outcomes reconcile before retry. Proven refusal resolves both unknown phases. Persist past facts and phase together under revision CAS.

relations.subject: ConstructionEvidence
relations.invariant: Completion consumes a verified entry receipt and exact output, with one independent result per required spec. Preserve inherited compatibility.

relations.subject: AdmissionBoundary
relations.invariant: Native draft persistence is inert. Authority becomes visible through a single compare-and-swap on the qualified snapshot selector. All authoritative readers resolve via that selector. Refuse cutover with legacy readers still active. Native authority-changing transactions require their own complete atomic boundary and cannot be partially exposed.

relations.subject: OutcomePolicy
relations.invariant: Calculations construct results. Deterministic entry reference translation stays a Mapping.

relations.subject: JoinIdentity
relations.invariant: Derive storage key from the identity through a verified mapping. Persist identity and command tuple atomically. Replays return the original receipt. Different tuples conflict. Historical recovery reads by original identity across cuts.

relations.subject: VerificationPorts
relations.invariant: Validate registry carry-forward, unique identities, lookup targets, schema/generator pairing and projections before generating the closed publication bundle.

relations.subject: SelectionCoverage
relations.invariant: Allow a bounded 64-target review or fail explicitly. Derive the required set from the selected manifest, then compare exact coverage. Each obligation traces to the authored clause, contract, guard and fixture.

authority_relations.subject: Owner Decision
authority_relations.object: Exact Definition meaning or lifecycle proposal

authority_relations.subject: Independent Assessment
authority_relations.object: Exact entry receipt and generated output manifest
